note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Holding the items, recording them and referring them for assessment is the correct route.
Recording and referral come first. Testing, cleaning or disposal before assessment is refused.

practicalCriteria: The learner records each item with photographs and an owner decision.
The learner separates protected items from items that need referral.
The learner refuses to operate exposed electrical devices.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: An exposed electrical device would be operated without authorisation.
Disposal is proposed before owner consent and assessment.
